package.author: Tenzen Studio
package.description: Photon Studio is a free, fully featured alternative to Photoshop. Open and save PSD files, retouch photos, create designs and work offline.

en-US.author: Tenzen Studio
en-US.description: Photon Studio is a free, fully featured alternative to Photoshop. Open and save PSD files, retouch photos, create designs and work offline.
en-US.longDescription:
Photon Studio is an offline image editor with Photoshop-equivalent capabilities and native PSD support.
It opens and saves PSD and PSB files with layers, provides retouch tools such as healing and clone stamp, liquify and puppet warp, locally run AI selection, Camera RAW development, filters, typography and vector shapes, and Actions for automation. Everything runs locally; no account or subscription is required. A companion CLI is included for command-line editing.
en-US.name: Photon Studio

zh-CN.description: Photon Studio 是一款免费的全能 Photoshop 替代品。打开和保存 PSD 文件、修饰照片、进行设计，全程离线运行。
zh-CN.longDescription:
Photon Studio 是一款离线图像编辑器，具备与 Photoshop 相当的功能，并原生支持 PSD。
它可以打开和保存带图层的 PSD 和 PSB 文件，提供修复画笔、仿制图章等修饰工具，支持液化与操控变形、本地运行的 AI 选择、Camera RAW 显影、滤镜、文字与矢量形状，以及用于自动化的动作。所有处理均在本地完成，无需账号或订阅。应用还附带命令行工具，支持命令行编辑。
